checks.message: Verify the guardrail covers sensitive information filters, not just topic filters
checks.context: Guardrails without PII/sensitive data filters will happily return SSNs, credit card numbers, or API keys that appear in model responses. Enable sensitive information filters for any customer-facing application.

checks.message: Verify the data source IAM role is scoped to only the S3 buckets it needs
checks.context: Knowledge base roles with s3:GetObject on * can ingest data from any bucket in your account. Scope the role to the specific bucket ARN and prefix used for the knowledge base.

checks.message: Knowledge base not encrypted with a customer managed KMS key
checks.context: Knowledge bases store embeddings of your data. Without a CMK, you have no audit trail of who accessed the vector store and can't revoke access independently.

checks.message: Scope the agent execution role to only the action groups and knowledge bases it needs
checks.context: Agents with broad IAM permissions are a prompt injection risk — a malicious user input can instruct the agent to call AWS APIs it shouldn't. Least privilege is critical here.

checks.message: Associate a guardrail with this agent before exposing it to users
checks.context: Agents without guardrails can be manipulated via prompt injection to leak data, bypass instructions, or call unintended action groups. Guardrails are the primary defense layer for production agents.

checks.message: Verify logging destination is a secured S3 bucket or CloudWatch log group
checks.context: Model invocation logs contain the full prompt and response text. If the destination bucket is public or has overly permissive access, you're logging sensitive user data to an exposed location.

checks.message: Deleting a guardrail removes safety controls from all agents and flows using it
checks.context: Any agent or model invocation that referenced this guardrail will lose its content filtering, PII protection, and topic restrictions immediately. Verify no production workloads depend on it before deleting.

checks.message: Verify the Lambda function backing this action group validates all inputs
checks.context: Action group Lambda functions receive parameters extracted from user prompts by the LLM. A prompt injection attack can craft inputs that bypass your intended logic. Treat all action group inputs as untrusted.
